personajes.en: Plump mestiza woman, gray-streaked hair in a low bun, floral long-sleeve blouse and black ankle pants, worn sneakers. She holds a notepad and pencil behind a counter crammed with sachets, red apron pockets bulging with coins.

Afro-Colombian man with short curly graying hair, warm brown skin, navy bus-driver uniform shirt with ID badge, black trousers, polished lace-up shoes. Holds a printed route sheet and a thermos of coffee.

Rolera woman, olive skin, long dark hair with caramel highlights tied back, fitted mustard sweater, ripped skinny jeans, white sneakers, acrylic nails. Carries a round hairbrush and a spray bottle, small gold hoop earrings.

Costeño migrant man, dark brown skin, black short hair, open face, layered hoodie under a padded windbreaker against Bogotá's cold, cargo pants, worn trainers. Sling chest bag full of candy bars and phone chargers.

Slim mestizo young man, pale Andean features, straight black hair in a messy fringe, glasses, green university hooded jacket, dark jeans, worn Converse-style sneakers. Grey backpack with a laptop case and stainless steel thermos.

Broad-shouldered mestizo man, weathered tan skin, black mustache, hard hat pushed back, high-visibility green vest over a flannel shirt, sturdy work boots, tool belt. Faded blue jeans dusted with cement, yellow gloves tucked in his belt.

Diminutive pale-skinned woman with silver hair in a neat perm, deep-set bright eyes, wool ruana over a cardigan, long beige skirt, thick orthopedic shoes. Holds a folded umbrella and a rosary, handbag on her forearm.

Lean woman with copper-brown skin and high Andean cheekbones, black braided hair with grey streaks, colorful fingerless gloves, several worn jackets layered against the cold, rubber boots. Pushes a wooden cart, sack of sorted bottles on her back.

Bogotá tinto street vendor, 54, mestizo, short greying hair and grey stubble, plain dark baseball cap, navy rain jacket open over a khaki work shirt, jeans, sneakers, black work gloves, big orange thermos jug and a stack of small white plastic cups (from real reference photos of Bogotá tinteros)
